description: Call this when you want signed daily totals for one host. FREE. Signed daily aggregates for a host (counts, latency, quoted amounts, 402 checks, receipt ids, archive manifest location), newest first. Payee addresses are returned only as keyed HMAC-SHA256 hashes, not raw payTo. Raw archive NDJSON parts are not published.

as_of.description: UTC calendar day YYYY-MM-DD; returns what we recorded that day, or no check recorded

days.description: Number of newest UTC days to return, default 30, max 90

host.description: Hostname of a covered seller or MCP server, e.g. blockrun.ai

name: history
title: Daily History (Free)
